description: This script processes and analyzes timing data for layout tests, providing functionalities to group and identify the fastest tests based on timing metrics.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for processing timing data, parsing arguments, and invoking analysis functions.

methods.name: print_times
methods.description: Prints grouped timing data based on specified directory depth.

methods.name: print_fastest
methods.description: Identifies and prints the fastest tests based on timing thresholds.

methods.name: key_for
methods.description: Generates grouping keys for test paths based on forward or backward directory depth.

methods.name: times_by_key
methods.description: Aggregates timing data by generated keys for grouping.
